Military training and Joint Services Transcript

Bring your military training into the picture. Start with your service records and see where that learning could fit.

Add my military learning

Choose a degree plan to see where specific courses fit.

Study format
Record retrieval and university evaluation, not a generic open-enrollment course or promised fast earning route.
Pricing
No new-course price is assumed; institution-specific evaluation or transcript requirements may affect the process.
Assessments
Use official service and training records. Credit depends on the training version, dates, documented completion and receiving-school policy.
Credit type
ACE military-training recommendations recorded through qualifying service records; the receiving institution evaluates actual credit.

How the credit works

Before enrolling

  • Start with your degree plan to see the proposed receiving course or requirement.
  • Review any course-specific enrollment, equipment or assessment steps shown in your plan.
  • University decisions about your own records remain separate from published course matches.
